== Star Trek CCG ==
Lead photograph is the Friday hall portrait (fri58). Extra fri20 names him a Star Trek CCG finalist with Linda. The 1999 Worlds field is Decipher's Star Trek finalists list (Houston Open, marked 1998 Finalist). The 1998 Worlds row uses his squadron profile and that Finalist mark. The Round of 12 list omits him, so places stay blank. The 2008 Star Trek CCG World Champion Kevin Jaeger is a different person.
